title: ChatHealthy Specialty Classification Catalog (F-105)
description: ChatHealthy proprietary NUCC taxonomy overlay. Serves both as the source of ChatHealthy-specific flags (can_prescribe, homeopathic) for every NUCC code AND as the FHIR CodeSystem SUPPLEMENT for regulator-only codes NUCC does not publish. Each entry carries a canonical URL (system-URL + code anchor) for FHIR-compliant concept identification. Entries with is_supplemented=true carry the NUCC-equivalent metadata inline. Grounded in HL7 FHIR R5 CodeSystem-supplement pattern (https://hl7.org/fhir/R5/codesystem.html#supplements). See NUCC_SpecialtyCodeDataDiscrepancyManagement.docx for governance.

url.description: The canonical URL of this supplement file. Serves as the FHIR CodeSystem `url` (system identifier). Per-entry URLs extend this by appending #<code> as the anchor.
Canonical per-entry URL = supplement URL + '#' + code. Enables FHIR-compliant concept anchoring.

value.description: True for supplement entries (code not in current NUCC); false for normal NUCC-backed entries.

note.description: Curator note explaining the supplement provenance. Required when value=true.

display_name.description: Authoritative NUCC-equivalent display label for this code (used as taxonomies[i].code_label on provider records). Required on supplement entries so downstream consumers get a proper label instead of a derived-from-specialization fallback like 'Surgical' when the intended label is 'Surgical Technologist'.
